notes: North is up; the scan is turned slightly (Horne's block line drifts from x~315 at Liberty to ~283 at Courtland, E-W streets fall ~25-35 px from Horne to Dalton). Scale about 3.5 px/ft. Horne: only its east block line is on the sheet and the paper edge is at x~218-222, so Horne centres (block line minus 25 ft, ~87 px) sit right at or up to ~20 px past the paper edge. Dalton Av.: only its west side is on the sheet (x~3848 Liberty-Wilstach, ~3835 Wilstach-Wade, ~3828 Stille factory wall north of Wade, ~3780-3790 south of Wade; the north-of-Liberty outline is at ~3807); centres taken 30 ft (~105 px) east of the local line, at or just inside the paper edge (~3925-3937); the double dashed line at x~3862-3892 is the 10" water pipe, not the centre. A '5?' cut by the paper edge at x~3890, y~925 may be a 50' label for Dalton's first block; 60' is printed at Liberty, Wade and Flint. McLean Av. (100' printed) is the C.N.O.&T.P./C.H.&D. track corridor: west line x~1800 at Liberty drifting to ~1762 at Courtland, east line ~2120 at Liberty to ~2105 at Courtland (drawn ~320-345 px wide); centres taken midway. Wade west of McLean is not open: the Horne block line is drawn continuous across it and the right-of-way (block lines y~2221 and ~2402) carries a lumber-yard siding; Wade east of McLean is open (lines ~2252/2255 and ~2420/2433). The Bishop Wrecking & Lumber Co. name strip pasted along the south side of Wilstach east of McLean overlaps the street; the true south line is the lot line at y~1651. Courtland printed 'COURTLAND (FLORENCE)'; it runs from Horne to the railroad at x~1762 and does not continue east of McLean (nothing drawn there; sheet 69). 'L.P. / DRIVE' strip in block 4 and the 'LUMB' strip in block 2 are private yard drives, not streets.
